% A revtex4-2 article without hyperref: a \label in a heading's title,
% headings with no text between them, two \paragraph headings, an
% appendix with a subsection.
\documentclass{revtex4-2}
\begin{document}
\title{Revhead plain}
\author{Someone}
\maketitle
\section{Introduction\label{sec:intro}}
Text of the introduction, before section~\ref{sec:nested}.
\section{Nested}\label{sec:nested}
\subsection{Nested subsection}
\subsubsection{Nested subsubsection}
Text after the nested headings.
\paragraph{One.}
Text of the first paragraph.
\paragraph{Two.}
Text of the second paragraph, after section~\ref{sec:intro} and
appendix~\ref{app:a}.
\appendix
\section{Details}\label{app:a}
Text of the appendix.
\subsection{Part}
Text of the appendix's part.
\end{document}
